control_profile: Symmetric twenty-percent volatility target only; position stops, cooldowns, drawdown brakes, time stops, and turnover clipping are disabled.
falsifier: Reject the control-ablation thesis if removing the stop, cooldown, brake, and turnover cap does not reduce annualized turnover and cost share while preserving both funding-unwind roles.
formation_horizon: latest settled funding event standardized against forty-two prior events, with three completed price-confirmation bars outside chop
hypothesis: The funding-unwind signal has positive gross price and funding PnL in both roles, but repeated position-stop exits and cooldown re-entry create avoidable turnover; a volatility-only overlay should retain the mechanism with less churn.
rebalance_horizon: daily cohorts with three-day confirmed-unwind and seven-day chop-extreme shadow portfolios
